value.title: Where Lahore’s Property Market Is Moving in 2026
value.excerpt: A more selective market is rewarding completed infrastructure, livable neighborhoods and realistic pricing over speculative promises.

content.text: This is sample editorial content. Lahore’s property market is entering a period defined less by broad-based appreciation and more by a careful distinction between places people can use now and projects that still rely on future promises.
The return of the end user

Buyers are paying closer attention to access, utilities, schools and daily convenience. That shift gives established neighborhoods an advantage and forces newer schemes to compete on delivery rather than advertising.
In a selective market, infrastructure is not a footnote. It is the asset.
What investors should watch
Transaction depth, not only asking prices
Completion of access roads and utility networks
Rental demand from actual residents

value.title: The New Investment Map of Islamabad
value.excerpt: Capital flows are moving beyond familiar sectors—but access, approvals and delivery remain the filters that matter.

content.text: This is sample editorial content. Islamabad’s investment geography is widening as apartments, mixed-use projects and western growth corridors compete with the capital’s established sectors.
A broader market, not an easier one
The opportunity set is larger, but investors need stronger filters. Legal status, developer track record, road access and realistic rental demand should carry more weight than launch-stage discounts.

value.title: What Higher Construction Costs Mean for Pakistan’s Housing Market
value.excerpt: Cost pressure is changing project design, payment plans and the economics of new housing supply.

content.text: This is sample editorial content. Higher material and financing costs are forcing developers to redesign unit mixes, phase construction more carefully and revisit payment schedules.
Smaller units, slower delivery
The adjustment is visible in more compact floor plans and longer development timelines. Buyers should compare specifications closely and understand which costs remain variable.
